# visual-agents-workflow

> 可点击的**单 Agent** 工作流沙盘（对齐 dsh headless：用户 / 助手 / 工具）。剧本模拟 + 近似实时直播 + 本机 dsh 真实任务。
> Clickable **single-agent** workflow sandbox aligned with `dsh --profile headless`: User ↔ Agent ↔ Tools. Scripted playback, demo live stream, local SSE / Task API.

- Repo: https://github.com/kanjiandahai/visual-agents-workflow
- Live demo (GitHub Pages): https://kanjiandahai.github.io/visual-agents-workflow/
- Multi-agent demo (additive): https://kanjiandahai.github.io/visual-agents-workflow/multi-agent.html
- License: MIT
- Stack: static HTML/CSS/JS in `docs/` + optional Node SSE bridge in `server/`

## What it is

Interactive sandbox that visualizes a **User → Agent → Tools → Agent → User** loop (one Agent by default). A separate page visualizes dsh parent→child delegation (`subagent` / `subagent_fork`).

| Mode | Backend needed? | Use |
|------|-----------------|-----|
| 剧本模拟 / Script | No | Step through a built-in single-agent playbook |
| 演示直播 / Demo live | No (works on Pages) | In-browser timed event injection |
| SSE live | Yes (`server/sse-server.js`) | Stream real agent events |
| 真实任务 / Real task | Yes + local `dsh` or `scripts/fake-dsh.sh` | `POST /tasks` runs a prompt; maps stdout/`--json` to user/agent/tools |

## Canvas

| Node id | Label | Role |
|---------|-------|------|
| `user` | 用户 / User | Submits the task, receives the reply |
| `agent` | 助手 / Agent | The single dsh agent |
| `tools` | 工具 / Tools | Tool calls (Read, bash, …) |

Edges: `e-user-agent`, `e-agent-tools`, `e-tools-agent`, `e-agent-user`. Event `agent` field: `user` \| `agent` \| `tools` \| `system`.

## Run locally

```bash
git clone https://github.com/kanjiandahai/visual-agents-workflow.git
cd visual-agents-workflow

# Static only (script + demo live)
python3 -m http.server 8080 --directory docs
# http://localhost:8080

# Static + SSE + Task API
node server/sse-server.js
# http://127.0.0.1:8787
```

## Key paths

| Path | Role |
|------|------|
| `docs/index.html` | Default single-agent UI (script / live / task form) |
| `docs/app.js` | Single-agent state machine, playbook, demo live, SSE, tasks |
| `docs/multi-agent.html` | Additive multi-agent UI (dsh subagent topology) |
| `docs/multi-agent.js` | Multi-agent playbook + live mapping |
| `docs/MULTI_AGENT.md` | Multi-agent demo notes |
| `docs/styles.css` | Styles |
| `docs/REAL_TASKS.md` | Real-task wiring plan + phase-1 dsh guide |
| `docs/sample/` | Sample NDJSON (including `multi-agent-*.jsonl`) |
| `docs/llms.txt` | Pages-served copy of this file |
| `server/sse-server.js` | SSE `/events`, `/emit`, `/tasks`, `/tasks/multi`, static `docs/` |
| `server/task-runner.js` | `dsh` / `fake-dsh` → events (default single-agent; `mode=multi` maps child nodes) |
| `scripts/fake-dsh.sh` | Fallback CLI when `dsh` is missing |

## HTTP API (local SSE server, default `127.0.0.1:8787`)

| Method | Path | Notes |
|--------|------|-------|
| `GET` | `/` | Sandbox UI |
| `GET` | `/health` | Health + runner hint |
| `GET` | `/runner` | `{ runner_kind: "dsh" \| "fake-dsh", topology: "user-agent-tools", ... }` |
| `GET` | `/events` | SSE stream (event name `agent`) |
| `POST` | `/emit` | Push one JSON agent event |
| `POST` | `/tasks` | Body `{ "prompt": "…", "mode"?: "multi" }` → `{ task_id, runner_kind }` (default single-agent) |
| `POST` | `/tasks/multi` | Same, forces `mode: "multi"` |
| `GET` | `/tasks` | List tasks |
| `GET` | `/tasks/:id` | Task detail |

Env: `PORT`, `HOST`, `DSH_BIN`, `DSH_PROFILE` (default `headless`), `DSH_JSON` (`0` disables `--json`). Do not commit API keys.

## Event schema (summary)

JSON fields: `ts`, `agent` (`user`/`agent`/`tools`/`system`), `type` (`task_start`/`status`/`tool`/`message`/`handoff`/`complete`/`error`), `message`, `edge`, `state`, `activeNodes`, plus `task_id` / `step` / `tool` / `status` for real tasks.

Full guide: https://github.com/kanjiandahai/visual-agents-workflow/blob/main/docs/REAL_TASKS.md
